blocks.html: This game was part of a week-long Game Jam. I was the lead artist, coder, and game designer. I worked with one other person who helped with several art assets and limited programming. My main role was creating enemy AI and world design which used a chunk loading system to increase overall performance.

items: Created all the pixel art in a module design for reuse
AI uses a faction system allowing different ai to fight each other
AI uses a field of view so you can sneak up behind them
Engineered a modular wave system for quick and easy to make objectives
Created a system for chunk map-loading optimizing performance
